401 Unauthorized when creating a batch with invalid API key

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

do {
    let _req = try LiterLlm.createBatchRequestFromJson("{\"completion_window\":\"24h\",\"endpoint\":\"/v1/chat/completions\",\"input_file_id\":\"file-abc123\"}")
    guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
    let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
    _ = try await _client.createBatch(_req)
} catch {
    print("\(type(of: error)): \(error)")
}
```
